_meta.purpose: Seed for the future pricing registry (AI infrastructure brief section 9.2). Not authoritative; every record is unverified until an administrator reviews it (brief 9.4).
_meta.rateConvention: unitRate is a decimal string; unit states the denominator.
_meta.schemaNotes: serviceTier: standard, batch, fast, priority, ultrafast. contextBand: a price band within a model (null = none stated). scheduledChange: a later price the provider page shows, with the date it states. pricingVersion: the version or date shown on the source page, or a note that none is shown. effectiveDate is null throughout: no source page states when the current price took effect. Model IDs are those listed on the retrieval date and are not permanent. Prices were read from the provider pages by an automated fetch and summariser; each record needs a human check against the source (verified is false).
_meta.gaps: Anthropic pricing page lists display names, not API model ID strings, for most models (modelId null). Vertex AI pricing page could not be retrieved as text, so there are no Vertex records. Only a selection of each provider catalogue is seeded (current text and reasoning lines, embeddings, main tools); legacy and fine-tuning prices are omitted.
